Product Profile
CR Dhan 100, also known as Satyabhama, is a 110-day variety released by ICAR-NRRI in the year of 2012. With medium height and medium slender grain, this variety is suitable for irrigated upland ecosystem where water deficit is recurrent. CR Dhan 100 exhibits resistance to leaf blight and rice tungro virus. The observed grain yield of this variety is 2.3 tons per hectare under drought condition and in favourable condition average yield of 4.7 tons per hectare can be realized. CR Dhan 100 has the tolerance to glume discoloration.
